swaps.to_item: A folding cotton or canvas tote
swaps.why: One tote replaces hundreds of thin bags that tear quickly and end up as litter.
swaps.tip: Keep one folded in your car and one clipped to your keys so it is there when you shop.

swaps.to_item: Beeswax wraps or a plate over the bowl
swaps.why: Wraps are washable and last about a year; a plate costs nothing.
swaps.tip: Warm the wrap in your hands so it grips the bowl's edge.

swaps.to_item: A filter jug and a steel bottle
swaps.why: You scanned mostly plastic bottles; refilling one bottle removes that stream.
swaps.tip: Fill the bottle the night before and keep it by your keys.

history_insight: You scanned 6 plastic bottles this month.
